title: `merge <batch-pr> --confirm` on a draft batch PR goes through `--batch-build NAME --ready`
why: Round 3 on #2378 (lane batch-freeze-lane-set-enforce, session_013NEJL1SSD89Hzb8ahrTmfs), via the coordinator 23:55 CST Nov 8: `--confirm` on a draft batch PR still runs the old draft_step, with no lane lint and no freeze block, then Host.ready.
